name: POM Pilots
summary:
POM Pilots, let's fly! Take to the air and help Bomb, Buck, and Bird as you explore the Airport, Park, and Farm. Complete the challenges as fast as you can to earn biscuits, Silver Cups, and unlock upgraded POM Planes!
Take on 30 challenges ranging from racing around the Airport, watering crops at the farm, and defending the Park from problematic Paper Planes.
